sources.quote: Harold & Pauline Price Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation | UCLA Anderson School of Management Skip to Search Skip to Main Content Skip to Footer Links UCLA Ziman Institute for Real Estate and Urban Economics Apply Open Menu Price Center for Entrepreneurship & Innovation Price Center for Entrepreneurship & Innovation Home Harold & Pauline Price Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation UCLA Anderson and the Price Center are at the hub of an incredibly rich entrepreneurial ecosystem. As an engine of positive change in California and across the globe, we are creating the future. The Harold and Pauline Price Center for Entrepreneurship & Innovation offers a wide range of resources to support the academic and professional development of entrepreneurial leaders. Our research initiatives advance the theory and practice of entrepreneurship and innovation, while our course offerings, experiential learning activities and non-degree certificate programs prepare MBA students, undergraduates and working professionals to study, launch and manage growing ventures that will change the way we learn, work and live.
